name: Stanford University
body: Preloaded HSTS, a nonce-based content security policy, a Permissions-Policy, and framing denied: Security 86. But the home page names stanford.edu/home as canonical, and that URL answers 404.
lesson: Fetch every canonical URL in your test suite. It should answer 200 and name itself as canonical.
summary: www.stanford.edu scores 86 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 13 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 44/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 12.2 s, Total Blocking Time 736 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.001, Speed Index 6.1 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 1 page names another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: / → /home. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: The sitemap lists 1 page search engines should not index
fix.fix: List only live, canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 6 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', script-src allows any host.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
